shared.name: using-agentic-os
shared.description: Use at the start of any conversation, and when deciding where to author, override or configure a capability or where a piece of context belongs.

shared.name: template-authoring
shared.description: Use when it is open whether an existing template type fits a capability's purpose before a creator is dispatched, or when no type fits and a new one must be authored.

shared.name: skill-authoring
shared.description: Use when creating, configuring or editing a skill, or verifying and pressure-testing a compiled skill.

shared.name: session-lifecycle
shared.description: Use when working on session init, startup hooks, the handoff or the session-end steps; when debugging tasks.json, meta.json or plans.json; or when tracing why a session artifact is missing or malformed.

shared.name: hook-wiring
shared.description: Use when adding a new hook, mapping an event key onto a Claude Code event, changing the generated settings wiring, or debugging why a hook is not firing.

shared.name: hook-authoring
shared.description: Use when writing a new hook script, registering a hook in hooks.json, or wiring a project-level hook override in .agentic-os/hooks/hooks.json.

shared.name: fan-out-aggregate
shared.description: Use when acting as a dynamic-<pillar> orchestrator agent that decomposes a request into subtasks and spawns child subagents via the Agent tool. Covers workflow_id registration per child and aggregating from Agent() return payloads, including synthesizing an error-status object for a failed or malformed child result.

shared.name: context-evaluation-framework
shared.description: Use when classifying context inputs, performing gap analysis on agent/skill/command definitions, or evaluating artifact distribution across Push, Genuine Agent Context, Shared Infrastructure, and Task Payloads.

shared.name: command-authoring
shared.description: Use when registering a new slash command, choosing its type (script, tool, agent or loop), writing its blueprints, configuring its provider fields, or verifying a compiled command body.

shared.name: claude-memory
shared.description: Use when creating, editing or reading CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md or any .claude/rules/*.md file, in this project or a project that consumes this framework.

shared.name: claude-config
shared.description: Use when deciding the Claude Code fields of an agent, skill or command: model, tools, skills, memory, allowed-tools, paths.

shared.name: blueprint-authoring
shared.description: Use when deciding where a blueprint belongs: the tier (framework, adapter or project), the placeholder contract of a template type, the variable whitelist, the resolver chain, and blueprint lookup.

shared.name: bash-utility
shared.description: Use when writing or reviewing any bash script in this project, or when debugging a set -e crash, logging configuration or environment variable loading.

shared.name: bash-framework
shared.description: Use when authoring a bash library, module command, hook script or provider adapter, in the framework (bin/lib, bin/modules, bin/hooks, bin/adapters) or in a project (.agentic-os/bin).

shared.name: agent-authoring
shared.description: Use when registering a new agent, writing its blueprints, configuring its provider fields, or verifying a compiled agent body.

shared.name: scope-rule-lookup
shared.description: Use when an agent is about to write, edit, move or delete a file and has not yet read the context rule file of the scope the target path belongs to.

shared.name: plan-drafting
shared.description: Use when an agent drafts a plan for a session from its backlog items and a proposal, checks the proposal against the capability inventories, or selects which items to plan.

shared.name: creator-contract
shared.description: Use when a creator agent (agent-author, skill-author, command-author) receives a task payload with a resolved template type and tier and a Project Facts section to write into a capability.

shared.name: capability-review
shared.description: Use when reviewing an authored skill, agent or command before it lands, or when a developer post-processes a compiled capability by hand and needs each defect sorted into a known category.

shared.name: blueprint-writing
shared.description: Use when writing or editing the body of a blueprint file, once its tier and placeholder are settled.
